d:
Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, CM Yogi Adityanath launched a sharp attack on Akhilesh Yadav and Asaduddin Owaisi. Taking a dig at Owaisi, Yogi called him a 'Maulana from Hyderabad' and challenged Akhilesh Yadav to contest elections against him from Ayodhya.
